Line.DefaultText:
"Yes, brave one..."

The hag smiles at you with her empty eyes.
Line.Text: “好，勇敢的家伙……”老巫婆朝你微笑，眼神空洞。

"Yes, brave one..."

The hag smiles at you with her empty eyes.

Line.DefaultText: What can we do for you?
Line.en: What can we do for you?
Line.ja: What can we do for you?

Line.DefaultText: Very well. We can teach you a thing or two. NIGHT BROTH LEARNED
Line.Text: 很好。我们可以教你一两招。\n\nd暗夜浓汤已习得
Line.zh: 很好。我们可以教你一两招。\n\nd暗夜浓汤已习得

Line.DefaultText:
Yes... we see it.

You're carrying so much. Let us lighten your load.

Whatever you no longer want, we can carry back into our pond.
Line.Text:
是的……我们看到了。

你身负重重，让我们替你卸下一些。

凡你所弃之物，我们皆可携回塘中。

It was good seeing you, brave one.

We will meet again...

很好。

很高兴见到你，勇敢的人。
我们还会再见的……

Line.DefaultText: Good. We will take your hunger and keep it beneath the water then. It will no longer gnaw at you. Your belly will never cry again. HUNGER BARGAIN STRUCK
Line.Text: 很好。 我们便将汝之饥饿携走，藏于水底。 它不再啮咬你身，汝腹亦永不复哀鸣。 饥馑之契已立”

Line.DefaultText: Good. We will take your fear and drown it in the water then. The wolves will seem no larger than rabbits. The cliffs no steeper than gentle hills. FEAR BARGAIN STRUCK
Line.Text: 很好。我们便将汝之恐惧携走，溺于水底。 群狼视之不过如兔，峭壁望之亦不逾缓丘。 恐惧之契已立

Line.DefaultText: It does not wish to leave with us. Very well. Then we shall make it yours forever. A small and faithful rot. It will linger at your side and keep the hungrier sicknesses from finding a home within you. HEALTH BARGAIN STRUCK
Line.Text: 其不愿随我等而去。 善哉。那我们便使其永属汝身——一小簇忠腐，常伴不离。 它将傍汝左右，令诸般贪疾无以寓于汝体。 康健之契已立
